text: The Bug 1973124 port removes max-run-time:1800 only from tasks.shippable-l10n-mac-notarization. The kind keeps its shippable-l10n-mac-signing dependency, chunk-locales grouping and copied attributes. Fixed accepted source also omits this field. Keep this observation scoped to the owned kind; imported payload builders and their timeout defaults were not inspected. Bugzilla records the landing and later ESR 140 uplift, not a new generated-task or worker test.
title: The mac localization notarization kind no longer sets max-run-time
